profile.name: Shridhar Patil
profile.headline: Python Developer building practical software and data-driven solutions.
profile.bio: I'm a Computer Science Engineering student at S. G. Balekundri Institute of Technology in Belagavi, graduating in 2027. I enjoy building small, useful applications with Python and Flask, and I'm most interested in the point where software meets data: cleaning messy datasets, analysing them, and turning the results into something people can act on. Lately I've been working with generative AI and RAG-based applications, and I'm currently a Data Analyst Intern in Bengaluru, where I use Python, Pandas and NumPy for cleaning, validation and exploratory analysis.
profile.intro_developer: I build backend applications and full-stack web tools with Python and Flask: REST APIs, database-backed features and AI-powered applications, including a cattle and buffalo breed classifier and an AI lifestyle coach. I try to start from a real problem and finish with something someone can actually use.
profile.intro_analyst: I work with data from raw to readable. My analysis uses Python with Pandas and NumPy, alongside Excel, SQL and Power BI for dashboards. Recent work covers rainfall variation and forecasting, school-education data for 36 states and union territories, and pay equity analysis with recommendations.
